program_narrative: Program UTLVAL00 is a batch data-validation utility driven by a control file. It opens the sequential VALIDATION-CONTROL file, the indexed POSITION-MASTER and TRANSACTION-HISTORY files (input) and the 132-byte ERROR-REPORT (output), and resets its validation totals. The main loop reads each control record until end of file and dispatches on its validation type: 'INTEGRITY', 'XREF', 'FORMAT' or 'BALANCE' run position and transaction integrity, cross-reference and format checks or position accumulation and balance verification. Those eight check paragraphs are not present in the source, so the actual validation rules are unknown. Error conditions handled: any open failure and any unrecognised validation type are counted, flagged and written as an error line to ERROR-REPORT, but processing continues; the program ends by closing all four files.

OPEN TRANSACTION-HISTORY for READ-ONLY  -- indexed, dynamic access by TRAN-KEY; status -> ws_tran_status

CALL 9999-error-handler  -- writes to the report file that just failed to open
